text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, upon stopping by a Japanese sweets shop, a familiar voice reached my ears—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother dear~.
My stomach is rumbling so~~~~.

text_block_list.name: Confectionery Shop Elder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a spoiled darling you are,
No Reason-chan. Here, have some manjū~.

text_block_list.name: Tea Shop Elder
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes her so adorable.
Ah, I've got plenty of tea refills for you as well.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~~, pure bliss, pure bliss!
Perhaps I shall become a grandchild of this household~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems No Reason is quite popular with the elderly.
However, even after that—

text_block_list.name: History-Loving Kid
text_block_list.text:
ALLL RIGHTTT!!
Got my third Date Masamune card!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Masamune~~!! Why wilt thou not come to me?!
I can eat no more chocolate at this rate~~!

text_block_list.name: History-Loving Kid
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, don't cry, ya big baby.
Here, I'll give you one of mine!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that the truth, young lad...?! 
...Kh, I have received thy loyalty
with all my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In front of the convenience store, it was the neighborhood kids.
And one day at the park—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—And there, charging in with the great spear
christened 'Tonbogiri' in hand,
was one of the Tokugawa Four Heavenly Kings, Honda Heihachirō Tadakatsu!!

text_block_list.name: Tourists
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! Awesome!"
"Tell us more, No Reason!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwahaha! Fret not!
I shall recount the magnificent, glorious charms
of the Sengoku era as much as your hearts desire!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoo-hoo!)
choice_data_list: You sure get along with all kinds of people.

text_block_list.text: Right~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for surprising you out of nowhere.
I just really felt like agreeing with you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-chan is
always like that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She hits it off immediately even with complete strangers.
Eve~ryone gets swept up into her pace.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: What is this, what is this? Speak ye of me?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Call out to me if thou art here; do not be so distant!
Miracle, and—
thou art an Academy Trainer, yes?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hahan! I see the two of you were singing my praises!
Come, there is no need for modesty, speak it directly to me!
choice_data_list: I was just thinking how amazing it is that you have so many friends.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hah, is that all! 'Tis only natural!
For being beloved by all people
is also the mark of a true commander!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Neither Miracle nor Trainer need hold back!
Come, fawn upon me to your hearts' content!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
See~? There you go again,
winning people over with that charm of yours.
choice_data_list: Maybe this charm is what makes her so appealing?
Though having you as a general does sound pretty fun!
Though having you as a general does sound pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
See~? There you go again,
winning people over with that charm of yours.
choice_data_list: Maybe this charm is what makes her so appealing?
Though having you as a general does sound pretty fun!
Though having you as a general does sound pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I mean, that's true and all, but~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Wait, don't tell me! Trainer-san, have you already been won over by her?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nyahaha, fret not! You may revere and worship me to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Setting aside the worshipping part, I couldn't help but smile at just how endearing she was.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Right, right! All right then, follow me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I was just about to hold a grand banquet with those foreign guests!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Come along, Trainer! Miracle! Off to the battlefield we go~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh~~, count me out~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the karaoke party with over a dozen attendees turned into a roaring celebration.
